units.title: Actual PBPS conditional C1 weak-resolvent tests

sources.label: PBPS Appendix C.1 omitted analytic domain prerequisite
sources.scope: Same actual compact-gradient graph closure admits C1 compact function/gradient pairs; actual positive-epsilon weak resolvent has all C1 compact weighted volume tests and genuine ordinary weak gradient. Actual PBPS reflected conditional R/S law and original fixed D precede epsilon/input. No local H2, global operator-core/Bochner, conditional Poincare/BL, centered epsilon limit, noncompact constant/linear domains, measurable y-selection, SPHMC Hessian lower/full4.1, PBPS hypocoercivity or either complete main/composition. TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.

assumptions: E has the same full-space finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel structure, including dimension zero. V is C2 with true all-point/all-direction alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I, alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, eta>0 and beta eta<=1.

The original Gibbs law, genuine independent Gaussian augmentation, selected R,S kernels, reflected W_y, finite positive partition and fixed original gradient D per fiber are derived by the existing actual conditional producer. Neither normalization nor a convenient replacement operator is supplied.

The potential is reflected, with quarter Hessian scaling. The unreflected SPHMC RGO potential/law is different. Existence is fiberwise for every y; no joint measurable resolvent selection, unbounded cost transfer or macroscopic H1/Poincare theorem is asserted.
units.statement: For actual C2 V with 0<alpha<=beta global Hessian bounds, eta>0 and beta eta<=1, construct the actual Gibbs-Gaussian augmentation and common Markov conditional kernels R,S, with disintegration R and S_y=(R_y)#(x->2x-y). S_y is the true normalized reflected Gibbs law for W_y(u)=V((y+u)/2)+norm(u-y)^2/(8eta), with C2 regularity and positive integrable weight. For every y, retain one dense closable exact compact-smooth gradient D, fixed before epsilon/input, and derive every positive-epsilon L2 forcing weak solution, ordinary weak gradient/local integrability and all C1 compact weighted volume test equations. No measurable solution selection in y is claimed.

steps.title: Use the actual common conditional kernels
steps.text: The existing conditional gradient producer constructs true Gibbs-Gaussian augmentation, Markov R/S, original disintegration and reflection pushforward. Every selected reflected fiber is an actual normalized density, not an abstract replacement.

steps.title: Keep the reflected source potential and partition
steps.text: Retain W_y(u)=V((y+u)/2)+norm(u-y)^2/(8eta), its true C2 regularity, integrable exp(-W_y) and positive partition. Its Hessian is one quarter of the unreflected shifted Hessian; no same-law/operator identification is used.

steps.title: Fix the original gradient before epsilon and input
steps.text: For each observation use the original dense closable exact compact smooth graph D supplied by that actual fiber. Its closure is closed, and the operator is fixed before arbitrary epsilon and forcing.

steps.title: Apply the real C1 weighted weak equation
steps.text: Reduce the true C2 potential to C1 and rewrite only the exact measure equality S_y=volume.tilted(-W_y). Apply the canonical C1 resolvent to that same original D, not another convenient operator.

steps.title: Carry every weak-gradient and integrability conclusion
steps.text: The ordinary volume weak-gradient identities, local integrability and all three weighted L1 products remain explicit in the actual fiber result. Tests instantiate a true nonquadratic potential and a compact norm^(3/2) observable with only C1 regularity.
steps.formula: \psi\in C_c^1,\quad u,\overline D_yu\in L^1_{loc}(du),\quad\text{three weighted products in }L^1.

steps.title: Retain fiberwise and full-paper boundaries
steps.text: No measurable y-selection of weak solutions is constructed, and no H2, generator-core/global Bochner, Poincare or macro H1 theorem follows just from the test upgrade. Both paper main results and actual-input cost composition remain unfinished.
steps.formula: \text{fiberwise weak tests}\ne\text{measurable joint selection or conditional Poincare}.
